lines.en: Chapter fifteen: On the line of the planets. Know that the signs have been distributed to the stars, just as the houses

lines.text: ایشان هر یک دو دارند الا شمس و قمر که هر یک یکی خانه دادند و انرا خط کوکب خوانند
lines.en: of them, each has two, except the Sun and Moon, to each of which they gave one house, and they call that the line of the planet.

lines.text: خط شمس در دهم داده اند و قمر در طالع و زحل در چهارم و هفتم و مشتری در دویم
lines.en: They have given the line of the Sun in the tenth, and the Moon in the ascendant, and Saturn in the fourth and seventh, and Jupiter in the second

lines.text: و یازدهم و مریخ در ششم و دوازدهم و زهره در پنجم و هشتم و عطارد در سیم و
lines.en: and eleventh, and Mars in the sixth and twelfth, and Venus in the fifth and eighth, and Mercury in the third and

lines.text: نهم از بهر آن خط شمس در دهم است که انجا قوي تر است از دیگر خانها و هر که در
lines.en: ninth. Because of that, the line of the Sun is in the tenth, for it is stronger there than in the other houses, and whoever is in

lines.text: عاشر بود شعاع خویش بر همه خانها افکند و از سمت الراس بود و از بهر انکه انخانه
lines.en: the tenth casts its rays upon all the houses and is from the zenith, and because that house

lines.text: عمل و سلطان و رفعت خوانند که افتاب دلالت بر بزرگی و رفعت کند اما ماه از بهر آن
lines.en: is called [the house of] action and sovereignty and elevation, for the Sun signifies greatness and elevation. But the Moon, because of that,

lines.text: خط در طالعست که دلالت با بتداي کند چون موافق یکدیگر اند و او را خط در طالع
lines.en: its line is in the ascendant, for it signifies beginnings, since they are in agreement with each other, and its line is in the ascendant

lines.text: نهاده اند و زحل از بهر انکه دلالت بر ترسی و بیم و مرگ کند بر زمینها خط وي در
lines.en: they have placed. And Saturn, because it signifies fear and terror and death upon the lands, its line is in

lines.text: رابع است و دیگر در ثامن است و خط مشتري در دویم و یازدهم که هر دو دلالت کنند
lines.en: the fourth, and the other is in the eighth. And the line of Jupiter is in the second and eleventh, for both signify

lines.text: بر نعمت و خیرات و دوستي اما مریخ از بهر آن اندر سادس و ثاني عشر است که هر دو دلالت
lines.en: bounty and good things and friendship. But Mars, because of that, is in the sixth and twelfth, for both signify

lines.text: کنند بر بیماري و اسبان دارند اما زهره خطش اندر سابع از بهر انکه دلالت بر
lines.en: illness and they have horses. But Venus, its line is in the seventh, because it signifies

lines.text: زنان کند و خط دیگرش اندر خامس است که دلالت بر عشق بازي و هدیها اما
lines.en: women, and its other line is in the fifth, which signifies lovemaking and gifts. But

lines.text: اما عطارد از بهر ان خطش اندر ثالث و تاسع است که هر دو دلالت باصناف علوم
lines.en: But Mercury, because of that, its portion is in the third and ninth, for both signify the various kinds of sciences

summary.headline: Planetary Lines and Triplicities
summary.text: Chapter fifteen explains the planetary lines, assigning the Sun, Moon, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury to specific astrological houses and relating those houses to sovereignty, beginnings, fear, bounty, illness, love, gifts, and sciences. A preceding table gives fiery, earthy, airy, and watery triplicities with their day and night rulers and numerical values.
